3. If it is a digit (0-9), shift it by 5 positions forward (wrapping around: (digit + 5) % 10).
4. If it is any other character (space, punctuation, etc.), leave it unchanged.
cipher.decrypt_rules:

1. If it is an uppercase letter (A-Z), shift it by 13 positions backward (which is the same as forward in ROT13), and convert it to lowercase.

4. If it is any other character, leave it unchanged.
